title: Faking RTX Global Illumination vs. RTX | 100% Ray-Traced Game, Pt 1
summary: Gamers Nexus builds a fully ray-traced demo in Unreal Engine to compare faked global illumination with RTX ray-traced GI. It covers the gains in dynamic scenes and accuracy against the performance cost and noise.
why: HN uses it as a reference for how noisy raw real-time ray tracing is and how it compares with traditional faked lighting.

quote.text: this extremely interesting video show state of the art techniques used to fake global illumination
